'''Kenholdt Ransard''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who was the spiritual leader and distillate maker in his [[Pnakotic Coast village|home village]] on the [[planet]] [[Savareen]]. His [[tongue]] was cut out by the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate when he and the other villages stood up to them; however, he was still able to maintain an effective silent communications network. In [[10 BBY]], he was present when the [[Cloud-Riders]] and a [[Beckett's gang|group of criminals]] formerly affiliated with Crimson Dawn joined together with the villagers to oppose the syndicate.

==Biography==
Ransard was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who lived in a [[Pnakotic Coast village|village]] constructed in the ruins of the [[Bis Refinery]] on the [[Pnakotic Coast]] of his [[homeworld]] [[Savareen]].<ref name="SoloOG" /> Like the other inhabitants of the village, he had had his [[tongue]] cut out by the [[Crimson Dawn]] syndicate after the villagers stood up to the criminals and refused to pay tribute.<ref name="Solo" /> He was the spiritual leader and the best distillate maker, his technique produced the best [[savareen brandy]] in the village.<ref name="SoloOG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kenholdt Ransard first appeared in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''<ref name="Solo" /> and was first named in the accompanying reference book ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="SoloOG" />
